articles.title: How is India Integrating Drones in its War-Fighting?
articles.summary: Drones are rapidly revolutionizing modern warfare, emerging as potent, cost-effective systems integrated into military arsenals globally. Their increasing sophistication and tactical versatility are reshaping battlefields, offering significant advantages in surveillance, reconnaissance, and even strike capabilities. Aspiring officers must grasp drone technology's strategic implications for future defense operations and tactical planning.

articles.title: Ministry asks NSFs to create panels for global ties, Make in India
articles.summary: India's Sports Ministry has mandated national federations to form "Committees on International Relations." This aims to enhance cooperation with global sports bodies, facilitating joint training and participation in international events. For SSB aspirants, this initiative underscores India's strategic push to elevate its global sporting profile, emphasizing structured international engagement and administrative reforms for excellence.
